title: Feature Request - Notification mods for Android O(reo)
symptom: On Android Oreo 8.1, xdrip+ notification is always on top and expanded showing the graph, even with 'high priority notifications' and 'public notification' unchecked. The user wants the notification to be at the bottom of the notification list and collapsed by default.
evidence_quote: For whatever reason, even with the two notification settings unchecked in xdrip+, notification is always on top and expanded showing the graph.
